video_title: Can AJ Dybantsa Save the Wizards + Darryn Peterson Battles & Rookie Year Goals

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on expectations for the Washington Wizards and Utah
quotes.excerpt: I think Utah will ask me to do the same amount that Washington will be asking me.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: It does feel like the Wizards likely will have the number one spot, but Utah is also right there with number two. Shout out to Keonte George and what they are doing out there. You already have ties to Utah through BYU. How much do you think about the difference between those two situations?

text_blocks.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
text_blocks.text: I think I will have the same impact on whatever team I go to. I think Utah will ask me to do the same amount that Washington will be asking me, so it won't be too much of a difference.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his expected role and leadership with the Washington Wizards
quotes.excerpt: I think they will ask me to come in, make a defensive impact, but also be a leader.

text_blocks.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
text_blocks.text: What do you think Washington will be asking of you?

text_blocks.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
text_blocks.text: I think they will ask me to come in, make a defensive impact, but also be a leader at a young age. They have vets over there, they have Anthony Davis over there, they have Trae Young over there, but I think they want a young and hungry team that can go score the ball in transition.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the Washington Wizards' need for a franchise player
quotes.excerpt: They want to bring back what that culture is in that area to that organization.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: They want a franchise player. They want to revive that area. They want to bring back what that culture is in that area to that organization. You will be the number one pick, I believe that. As of right now, Washington has that pick. What they need is you. They need somebody that they can put this organization behind for the next decade. This is how they are looking at this. Can we put this organization behind AJ for the next decade?

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the rivalry between AJ Dybantsa and Darryn Peterson
quotes.excerpt: The person that sort of determines that besides you is Darryn Peterson of Kansas.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: The person that sort of determines that besides you is Darryn Peterson of Kansas. For the last several years, you both have been one and two, and in a lot of people's eyes, they are not really sure if it's going to be one or two. What's that back and forth been like with Darryn Peterson over the years?

text_blocks.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
text_blocks.text: I was class of 2026 before I reclassed back up. I was light years better than everybody until I got back in that class and he gave me a run for my money. It just makes me more competitive, keeps me motivated.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on overcoming adversity and losing in his development
quotes.excerpt: Me never winning actually helped me because a lot of people can get complacent.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: What adversities or what challenges do you think have helped you grow the most to this point in your journey?

text_blocks.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
text_blocks.text: Me never winning actually helped me because a lot of people can get complacent. When you win, you are used to it, so when you don't win, you don't know what to do. I have been in teams and situations where I haven't been winning. I lost in the first round last year, I didn't win Big 12, I didn't make it to Chipotle Nationals. So I have to keep finding ways to win. When I hit my peak, I will be winning, rather than me winning now and when I'm losing I don't know how to deal with losing.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his rate of improvement and film study
quotes.excerpt: My rate of improvement throughout the season is actually ridiculous.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: What are your small goals throughout the course of the season?

text_blocks.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
text_blocks.text: My rate of improvement throughout the season is actually ridiculous. If you watch my first game reads versus my last game reads, it's night and day, especially the film I watch. I have only played 35 games, so that's half a season. Imagine if you give me 82 games to just watch film, and I have a coach dedicated to watch film with me and unlimited gym access. Those are going to be the smaller wins for me. In the beginning of the season, you are averaging 15, five and five; at the end of the season, you are averaging 26 and seven.
